entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I got a response from Kitagawa-kun.[n]He said he wants me to come over[n]after school today.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Perfect! Probably dropped all his[n]plans just to get you over there.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We need to find out from Kitagawa-kun[n]if what we saw in the Palace was true...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, quiet down. It's that student council[n]president.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yikes... She got a hold of Mishima today?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It'd suck if she noticed us. C'mon, let's[n]split up.
